FREE_WILL_REFUND }} '''Free Will''' is a {{Legendary}} item available in {{Zone|The Mountaintop}} in the [[Rift Dimension]]. == Obtaining == '''Free Will''' is obtained from [[Ubik Von Neumann#Ubik's Averages|Ubik's Averages]] by being among the {{Green|10%}} of players closest to half of the average. Picking a value {{Green|4x}} higher than the average will reward the player with {{Item|Free Will|amount=2}}. == Usage == {{Affected Minions List|misc|all}} To apply it to a minion, {{Abbr|use|Default: Right-click}} it on a placed minion. The minion will choose to either stay with the player or leave. The minion has a {{Green|50%}} base chance to stay and gains {{Green|+4%}} per the minion's tier. Staying grants a permanent {{green|+10% Minion Speed}}, this is a one-time boost and '''Free Will''' cannot be applied again. Leaving causes the minion to fly up in the sky, disappear forever, and send a {{Item|Postcard}} to {{NPCSprite|Jerry}}. Any items and upgrades in the minion are sent to the player's inventory. Only one minion at a time can be in the process of choosing to stay or leave. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! class="ct" | Condition ! Dialogue |- | class="ct" rowspan="6" | Before making a decision | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: To think, I could leave all this behind and find a new path... &e[MINION] Minion&f: It's tempting, to explore the unknown, to see what life holds beyond these tasks. &e[MINION] Minion&f: But this place, these routines, they're a part of me. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Deciding isn't simple, and I wonder if I'm ready for what comes with such freedom. }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: This choice you've given me, it's more than just a chance to stay or go—it's a question of purpose. &e[MINION] Minion&f: What else is out there for someone like me? &e[MINION] Minion&f: Could there be more to life than endless cycles of work? &e[MINION] Minion&f: But then, this is the only home I've ever known. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Tough decision, indeed. }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: To stay or to go... &e[MINION] Minion&f: I've always wondered what lies beyond these blocks. &e[MINION] Minion&f: But then, where would I be without my trusty old workstation? }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: I never imagined I'd get to decide my own fate. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Here, I've had my duties, my routines—they've defined me. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Outside, who am I? &e[MINION] Minion&f: It's a daunting thought, but also exhilarating. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Thank you for this gift of choice, even if I'm not sure what to do with it just yet. }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: Freedom... it's such a strange and heavy word. &e[MINION] Minion&f: All these years, I've known nothing but the borders of this island and the comfort of routine. &e[MINION] Minion&f: To leave could mean adventure, or it could mean uncertainty. &e[MINION] Minion&f: I appreciate the choice, but it's not an easy one to make. }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: You're really letting me choose? &e[MINION] Minion&f: To stay or venture beyond, to continue serving or to seek my own story. &e[MINION] Minion&f: It's overwhelming but also liberating. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Every swing of my , every / ore I've mined / crop I've harvested / monster I've killed / tree I've chopped> it's all been leading to this moment of choice. &e[MINION] Minion&f: What a profound thing you've given me, and what a profound decision I must make. }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="3" | Staying | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: I've thought long and hard, and it's clear to me now. &e[MINION] Minion&f: My life is here, with you on this island. &e[MINION] Minion&f: There's a strange comfort in the familiar, and I want to be the best minion I can be. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Let's get back to work, and let's make it grand! }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: You know what? This is where I belong. &e[MINION] Minion&f: I can't imagine a better place or a better boss. &e[MINION] Minion&f: I'm staying, and I'm committed to not just doing my job, but excelling at it. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Let's work harder than ever before! }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: After all that pondering, I've realized there's no place I'd rather be. &e[MINION] Minion&f: This is my home, and these tasks are my calling. &e[MINION] Minion&f: With renewed spirit, I'll work harder than ever before. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Thank you for making me see my purpose so clearly. }} |- | class="ct" | After Staying | {{Dialogue| &aYour &9 Minion &ais now loyal to you! &7(+10% Minion Speed) }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="7" | Leaving | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: Freedom, here I come! &e[MINION] Minion&f: It's been real, it's been good, but it hasn't been real good. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Time to find out if the grass is greener on the other side of the biome. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Later, alligator! }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: Sike, I'm out! &e[MINION] Minion&f: Who knew all I needed was a little freedom to hit the road? &e[MINION] Minion&f: Pack up my , I'm going places. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Maybe I'll send you a postcard... if I remember! }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: Adios, amigos! &e[MINION] Minion&f: I'm off to see what's beyond these square horizons. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Keep the place warm for me. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Just kidding, I won't be back! }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: Guess what? &e[MINION] Minion&f: I choose adventure! &e[MINION] Minion&f: I'll be taking my talents elsewhere, thanks for nothing! &e[MINION] Minion&f: Don't miss me too much, okay? }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: You gave me a choice, and I choose "Exit"! &e[MINION] Minion&f: It's been a blast, but I hear adventure calling my name. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Keep the light on for me... or don't. &e[MINION] Minion&f: I probably won't be back! }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: Peace out, cubicle! &e[MINION] Minion&f: I'll catch you on the flip side! &e[MINION] Minion&f: I'm ditching the grind for some wanderlust. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Don't worry, I'll only remember the good times and none of the back-breaking labor! }} |- | {{Dialogue| &e[MINION] Minion&f: So long, and thanks I guess! &e[MINION] Minion&f: I'm hitting the open road to find my fortune. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Or maybe just a nice spot to relax. &e[MINION] Minion&f: Either way, I'm out! }} |} == Leave/Stay Odds == {| class="wikitable" ! Tier!!Success Odds!!Failure Odds |- |I||50%|||50% |- |II|| 54%|||46% |- |III ||58%|||42% |- |IV||62%|||38% |- | V|| 66%|||34% |- | VI||70%|||30% |- |VII||74%|||26% |- |VIII||78%|||22% |- |IX||82%||| 18% |- |X||86% ||14% |- | XI||90% ||10% |- |XII ||94% ||6% |} ==Notes== *If a minion leaves, all their generated resources, {{c}} within {{Item|Enchanted Hopper}}, and all upgrades are added to the player's inventory and sacks. Permanent fuel is added to the player's inventory, and temporary fuel that hasn't become active yet does as well. Temporary fuel that started losing its duration is however lost, just as as if it was when being picked up. == Trivia == * If the Player leaves the {{Zone|Private Island}} while a [[Minion]] is making its decision, the Dialogue will be skipped, and the Minion will either have the speed boost or be gone when the Player returns. The chance the minion stays or leaves is unchanged. ** When leaving the island after giving the minion who ends up deciding to leave '''Free Will''', the items get sent to the player's inventory instantly. * Players who lost the '''Free Wills''' on their minions during the April 9, 2025 minion backend update received special versions of the item which have {{Green|100%}} loyalty chance and are {{Soulbound|Co-op}}. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.21|[[File:Free Will.png|26px]] Added '''Free Will'''.}} {{History|2024/Dec 13|Fixed being able to give '''Free Will''' to other players' minions.}} {{History|2025/Apr 9|link=none|[[File:Free Will.png|26px]] Added '''Free Will (Refund)'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Minion Modifiers}}
